findings: All six inspected progress shapes changed from TableScan plus MajorSort to an ordered date DESC/document-ID DESC SequentialScan. Limits remain 60 per measurement/check-in source and 30 per photo source.
Both legacy and current photo collections remain supported. Field selection is preserved; no image URL or health data was queried.
These collection-scoped indexes support existing Core queries as well as the forthcoming progress-domain refresh. No Function redeploy or UI behavior change is required for index availability.
limitations: Planner-only evidence does not measure production read units, latency or currency savings. The adapted pipeline is a diagnostic representation of the Core shape.
Each index adds storage and write maintenance; verify the read benefit against representative write volume.
The SDK projection conversion issue is isolated to this diagnostic. Application source continues to use native Core queries tested in the Firestore emulator.
